tasks.short: Arrange vessel fuel, stores and repairs

steps.what: Confirm which ships need to be fueled, restocked with supplies, or repaired and capture actual requirements
inputs: crew's verified needs and next port schedule

steps.what: Find available approved fuel, stores or repair providers for the port call
Coordinate service timing, access and scope with the provider and port personnel
outputs: agreed service arrangements and unresolved exceptions

steps.what: Prepare the final fuel, stores or repair booking message
inputs: agreed service arrangements and unresolved exceptions

steps.what: Check and approve the completed booking scope, quantities, timing and recipient
inputs: agreed service arrangements and unresolved exceptions
outputs: approved vessel service booking v1 with recipient

steps.what: Send the approved booking to the named service provider
inputs: approved vessel service booking v1 with recipient

tasks.design: Use {PROCUREMENT} provider filters and {OPS_SYSTEM} actual requirements to prepare a structured booking in {EMAIL}. The captain or mate coordinates actual availability and approves the final booking and recipient before its separate send.
tasks.previous_blocker: Port-call arrangements can require provider lookup and repeated booking details.
tasks.enabler_now: Native provider filters and booking templates can reuse confirmed service fields.
tasks.still_hard: Coordinate a feasible service window with vessel and port conditions.
tasks.human_edge: Confirm actual needs and resolve service exceptions.

ambition.what: Reduce booking administration around retained service coordination.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: structured service bookings can be prepared from confirmed requirements and sent after human approval.

assumptions: Boundary is arranging service, not performing refuelling/repairs, measuring delivered quantities or paying invoices.

s1 counts capture of vessel/port, actual need, material specification/quantity or repair scope and constraints from actual checks. The existing directory owner maintains provider/contact, service type and port coverage. s3 obtains actual timing/access agreement; s4 counts entry of any new agreed details. Missing fields stay manual.

Native provider and booking features come first. Central reduces lookup by 30% and booking composition by 50%, and removes only a real current send. Physical checks and coordination remain unchanged; same-system saves earn nothing.
Approval follows the completed message and recipient; edits invalidate it. Provisional B=100, R=77, gross=23; focal upkeep=1; net=22. Shares are independent of means priors.
unknowns: Actual lookup, message and send effort
research_questions: Trace service arrangements from actual requirements to final booking and time exception handling.

already_counted.description: Verify final booking scope and recipient

incremental.description: Maintain booking-field mappings and inspect send failures

approvals.approved_version: approved vessel service booking v1 with recipient

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: native booking already covers the work. High: 23 gross points require six extra booking-exception hours and one upkeep hour, leaving 16.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Supervise deck, superstructure and bridge maintenance

steps.what: Observe crew cleaning or maintaining decks, superstructures and bridges
inputs: actual crew work and vessel condition

steps.what: Direct the crew's cleaning or maintenance and resolve work problems
outputs: understood crew directions and actual work response

steps.what: Inspect the resulting cleaning or maintenance quality
inputs: understood crew directions and actual work response
outputs: verified work condition and remaining defects

steps.what: Record and confirm actual supervision findings and remaining defects
inputs: verified work condition and remaining defects

steps.what: Save the approved supervision note in its current maintenance record

tasks.design: Retain on-vessel supervision and inspection at {OTHER}, the physical work areas. The captain or mate records actual findings in the existing {OPS_SYSTEM} maintenance form; no shorter inspection or automatic completion is assumed.
tasks.previous_blocker: Supervision depends on actual workmanship and vessel conditions.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing maintenance forms support capture but establish no additional saving.
tasks.still_hard: Verify quality and correct problems during the work.
tasks.human_edge: Direct people and inspect the actual result.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: maintenance forms retain findings but do not establish that physical supervision or inspection can be shortened.

assumptions: Boundary includes the captain/mate's supervision, inspection and finding note; crew labour is unchanged and excluded from focal savings.

s4 counts capture of location, actual condition, observed defects, time and follow-up from s3. A planned maintenance item is not evidence of completion. Native forms and templates are considered, but no duplicate entry or reduced factual capture is established.
Same-record save is effectively zero; minimum 1 is retained and final note precedes approval. Provisional B=100, R=100, gross=0; upkeep=0; net=0, independent of means priors.
unknowns: Whether a duplicate supervision record exists
research_questions: Observe supervision and trace the actual finding note before proposing automation.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Physical supervision and the separate actual-findings write remain fully counted; no additional mechanism changes them.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Specify the required supplies or equipment, actual quantities and delivery constraints
inputs: actual vessel needs and available stock

steps.what: Prepare the supplier quotation enquiry for the required supplies or equipment
Verify and approve the completed quotation enquiry and supplier recipients
outputs: approved quotation enquiry v1 with suppliers

steps.what: Send the approved quotation enquiry to the named suppliers
inputs: approved quotation enquiry v1 with suppliers

steps.what: Review returned supplier quotations and compare specification, price and delivery terms
Select the supplier and prepare the final purchase order with agreed terms
Approve the completed purchase order, commitment and supplier destination
outputs: approved vessel purchase order v1 with supplier

steps.what: Send the approved purchase order to the selected supplier
inputs: approved vessel purchase order v1 with supplier
outputs: vessel purchase order v1 sent to supplier

tasks.design: Configure {PROCUREMENT} enquiry templates, supplier comparisons and version-gated enquiry and purchase-order sends. The captain or mate confirms actual needs, selects the supplier and approves each completed outbound version independently.
tasks.previous_blocker: Supplier enquiries, quote comparisons and order delivery can require manual handling.
tasks.enabler_now: Native procurement workflows can reuse requirement fields and normalize structured quote lines.
tasks.still_hard: Judge specification fit and delivery reliability.
tasks.human_edge: Choose the supplier and accept the exact commitment.

ambition.what: Reduce purchasing administration while retaining selection and approval.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: procurement workflows can prepare enquiries, compare structured quote lines and send approved purchase orders.

assumptions: Boundary is purchasing through order delivery; receipt inspection and invoice payment are separate. Current purchasing authority must be confirmed; if another approver is required its unchanged review remains additional other-role work.

s1 counts actual item/specification, quantity, units, delivery port/date and constraints. Existing supplier owners maintain contacts. Suppliers produce quotation ID, matching line, quantity/unit, price/currency, validity and delivery terms in their normal responses. s5 includes reading responses and manual handling of unstructured or ambiguous quotes; no model infers equivalence.

Native procurement comes first. Central removes half of enquiry preparation and 40% of comparison work, plus distinct real enquiry/order sends. Same-system saving/filing earns no saving; physical need checks and supplier judgement remain unchanged.
Each final enquiry and order exists before its approval. Any changed content or recipient voids that approval. No order is approved before supplier selection and final terms exist.
Provisional B=100, R=70, gross=30; focal upkeep=1; net=29, independent of means priors.
unknowns: Current authority and real send effort
research_questions: Trace purchases from actual need to final supplier order and time quote exceptions and approvals.

already_counted.description: Verify final quotation enquiry and recipients

incremental.description: Maintain quote-field mappings and inspect outbound delivery failures

approvals.approved_version: approved quotation enquiry v1 with suppliers
approved vessel purchase order v1 with supplier

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: native procurement already handles these actions. High: 30 gross points require seven extra quote/delivery exception hours and one upkeep hour, leaving 22.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Tow barges or signal tugboats to their destinations

steps.what: Assess the barge, destination, route and actual towing conditions
inputs: actual traffic, weather and waterway conditions
outputs: assessed towing context and intended movement

steps.what: Confirm towing readiness and responsibilities with the crew or tugboats
inputs: assessed towing context and intended movement

steps.what: Tow and maneuver the barge when controlling the towing vessel
outputs: barge maneuvered under direct towing control

steps.what: Signal tugboats to maneuver the barge toward its destination when directing assisted towing
inputs: actual barge movement and tug response
outputs: barge movements directed through tugboat signals

tasks.design: Retain towing control and tugboat signalling with the captain or pilot, using existing {OPS_SYSTEM} navigation/control equipment and {TELEPHONY} radio. Neither an additional display nor automatic messages replace actual vessel-response judgement.
tasks.previous_blocker: Towing requires live coordination with changing vessel and waterway conditions.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing aids already support the work; no additional labour reduction is established.
tasks.still_hard: Judge barge response and secure coordinated tug actions.
tasks.human_edge: Control or direct the physical maneuver.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: barge towing and tugboat signalling require live observation and coordinated physical action.

assumptions: Boundary includes preparation, readiness, towing and tug signals. s3 and s4 represent the task's direct-control and assisted-towing modes across work instances, not a requirement to perform both on every tow. No separate report deliverable is hidden in these live actions.

Existing dispatch supplies barge/destination references; direct observation and crew/tug confirmation supply actual conditions and readiness. Planned readiness is never used as an actual confirmation. OTHER means the physical vessel and barge.

Native navigation/control aids are considered; their runtime is already automated. No invented lookup or copying baseline supports a saving, and no autonomous vessel-control or machine radio action is proposed.
Provisional B=100, R=100, gross=0; incremental=0; net=0, independent of means priors; mode mix does not affect this zero estimate.
unknowns: Actual mix of direct and assisted towing duties
research_questions: Observe towing and signalling separately from existing equipment runtime.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Preparation and live signals are explicit; no concrete change reduces the required physical control or coordination.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Vessel officers retain physical supervision and towing control; native procurement tools can reduce supported service and purchasing administration.
reach: Port providers: confirm actual service availability
Procurement owner: verify authority and supplier data
skills_to_grow: Capture actual needs rather than planned quantities
Check final booking and purchase commitments
role.ambitious_version: A vessel officer whose service and purchasing records are traceable while crew supervision and vessel control remain human.
